chemical_state_policy.canonicalization: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES after ordinary sanitization; no uncharging, tautomerization, fragment removal, or other rewriting
chemical_state_policy.undefined_stereochemistry: retain parent and record preparation failure
chemical_state_policy.multiple_components: retain parent and record preparation failure
chemical_state_policy.filters: Lipinski, Veber, Ghose, Muegge, QED, PAINS, and Brenk are descriptive only and cannot remove a benchmark parent

conformer_policy.seed_derivation: first 31 bits of SHA-256 over protocol_id, target_id, class label, canonical isomeric SMILES, source member path, physical line number, source identifier, and ETKDGv3 separated by NUL bytes; zero maps to one
conformer_policy.nonconverged_fallback: retain the lowest-energy nonconverged conformer as evidence and do not send it to Meeko

execution_policy.parallelism: logical processors minus one, capped by task count
